irregularities.title: No free key-less live odds feed for greyhounds
irregularities.detail: OLBG server HTML carries no structured prices; Sporting Life racecards show no pre-race prices; GBGB publishes the starting price only after the race. The 25-point odds-and-value category cannot be scored on a live card, odds-gated Step 3 tiers cannot fire, and HIGH confidence is unreachable live. SPs are used for the settled-race backtest only.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Odds component marked missing on every live tip; confidence capped at MEDIUM; value-target tier withheld.

irregularities.title: Analyst verdicts and tip-sheet narrative are paywalled
irregularities.detail: Timeform analyst verdicts and Sporting Life form summaries are not in the free racecard payload. They are never scored and never paraphrased.
irregularities.effect_on_output: No verdict-derived clauses; tips use measured form/trap/distance/grade factors only.

irregularities.title: Social-media sentiment deliberately excluded
irregularities.detail: The prompt instructs tipster/social sentiment to be used internally and never referenced. No structured free feed exists, so the factor is neither collected nor scored.

irregularities.title: Track handedness/configuration not in the official data
irregularities.detail: The greyhound adjustment for rail-trap bias on left-handed tracks needs per-track configuration, which GBGB does not publish as data. Trap scoring uses measured wins/places per trap instead.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Structural trap advantage measured from results, not assumed from layout.
